title: Pregnancy

inlines.v: PREG'NANCY, noun [See Pregnant.] The state of a female who has conceived, or is with child. 1. Fertility; fruitfulness; inventive power; as the pregnancy of wit or invention. Pregnance, in a like sense, is not used.
